stem:
A student lists two land features:

• Himalayas (mountain range)

• (East African) Great Rift Valley

Part A
Which statement describes how each land feature MOST LIKELY formed?

Part B
Which statement BEST explains the correct answer to Part A?
instruction: Select the best answer for Part A and the best answer for Part B.

options.label: A
options.text: The Himalayas formed at convergent boundaries, while the Great Rift Valley formed at divergent boundaries.

options.label: B
options.text: The Himalayas and the Great Rift Valley both formed at divergent boundaries.

options.label: C
options.text: The Himalayas formed at divergent boundaries, while the Great Rift Valley formed at convergent boundaries.

options.label: D
options.text: The Himalayas formed at convergent boundaries, while the Great Rift Valley formed at transform boundaries.

options.label: A
options.text: Tectonic plates are moving away from each other in areas that form both mountains and rift valleys.

options.label: B
options.text: Tectonic plates are moving away from each other in areas that form mountains, while tectonic plates are moving toward each other in areas that form rift valleys.

options.label: C
options.text: Tectonic plates are moving toward each other in areas that form mountains, while tectonic plates are sliding past each other in areas that form rift valleys.

options.label: D
options.text: Tectonic plates are moving toward each other in areas that form mountains, while tectonic plates are moving away from each other in areas that form rift valleys.
